diagram_title: bodesign R13 compute/landing split + WebDAV working-cache
function: Serve the C00-C07 PCB lifecycle with deterministic repo-local verbs executed on the host (landing plane) and heavy EDA compute in the container (compute plane), exchanging bulk files through a per-deliverable WebDAV working cache
inputs: WebDAV method requests from mount clients (rclone/davfs2)
Staged input trees (token or cache namespace)
controls: mcp.json instructions (R13.5 verb-class declaration: compute / landing / cache-lifecycle)
R13.6 self-containment: gate.py runs from skill dir with --repo only, hard-guards its scope
No-silent-fallback 天條: missing repo/packages/credential = typed error, never container fallback
R2 token contract (TTL, size cap, traversal defence) for remote compute paths
AuthProvider identity resolution (Basic per-owner credential, typed 401/403)
outputs: Files written directly into caller repo (landing verbs)
Produced heavy artifacts (kicad_pcb, gerbers, STEP, renders, sim reports)
Mountable per-deliverable cache namespace + DAV responses
Artifacts exported (landed) into caller truth store
Typed errors (LANDING_*, VERB_*, AUTH_*, EXPORT_*, WORKSPACE_*)
mechanisms: services/mcp/server.py MCP tool registry (heavy + vault + cache lifecycle)
pcbnew / kicad-cli / ngspice / OpenSCAD / build123d / pyrender / LibreDWG / LibreOffice / pygerber / freerouting
